title: Concept: Object injection via unserialize in php — review required
description: In php, unserialize() turns a string into objects. Because the payload names its own classes, an attacker who controls the string chooses which constructors run on the way in and which destructors run on the way out. That is the entry point for PHP object-injection chains that end in file writes or command execution.
applicability: php applications that decode cookies, queue messages, or cache entries with unserialize.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution; HIGH severity.
